subject: Observability add-ons: step-pricing for seatless retention + tracing overlay
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-retail.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acme-retail.com>, contracts@acme-retail.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability needs — retention + tracing packaging question

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We like the look of Redwood’s observability add-ons, but our procurement team pushed back on the mix of seat-based dashboard pricing and per-GB retention credits — it complicates our internal chargebacks.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you propose a seatless retention SKU that bundles long-tail storage (30–90 day) with a predictable monthly credit?
- What’s the commercial overlay if we want tracing at 100% sample for hotpaths and 5% for background jobs? We need a pricing delta to present to finance.

We’re aiming to finalize commitments by the end of Q4 if numbers look reasonable. I attached our rough ingest sample for sizing.

Best,
Samir
Director of Infrastructure
Acme Retail

Attachment: retention-sample-metrics.csv (csv, 47KB)

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-retail.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability needs — retention + tracing packaging question

Samir — thanks for the clear asks and the sample. Looping in Ben (commercial) and Jordan (product) to line up options.

High level — two pragmatic options we usually offer for customers in your size:
1) Seatless retention bundle: a committed monthly ingest credit that covers 30/60/90-day tiers with a built-in archive compression factor. This removes dashboard seat licensing and lets you map cost to GB/month.
2) Hybrid overlay: seat-based dashboards for core teams + seatless retention credits for long-tail telemetry. Often preferred if you want role-based UI access but predictable storage costs.

For tracing we can price by effective span-rate after sampling: for hotpaths (full sampling) we estimate ~X tokens/span cost; for background (5%) we model a blended rate. Jordan — I’ve attached Samir’s sample; can you confirm the recommended retention tiers and an example blended price per ingest credit?

Next steps suggested: we’ll put together a 2-option commercial worksheet (monthly committed credits + a one-time onboarding credit) and return by EOD Wed. If procurement wants a single-line budget number for finance, Ben can provide a committed discount path.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_addons_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing workbook)

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-retail.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability needs — retention + tracing packaging question

Samir — quick commercial proposal ahead of the worksheet:

Option A (Seatless retention bundle):
- Committed monthly ingest credit: 60TB/month (covers your current baseline + 20% buffer)
- 30/60/90-day tiers priced as a single blended $/GB/month with a 15% onboarding credit for the first 3 months
- Commitment tiers: 12-month (standard), 24-month (additional 7% off).
- Example: 60TB/month blended rate = $0.018/GB/month post-commit (illustrative).

Option B (Hybrid overlay):
- Seat licenses for 25 dashboards + 30TB/month seatless retention credits for long-tail
- Lower seat license rate if you sign 24 months (we can add 10% seat discount).

Tracing overlay pricing (applies on top of either option):
- Hotpath full-sample delta: +$0.006/GB of traced span ingress (uncompressed equivalent)
- Background sampled at 5%: +$0.0003/GB
- We can cap trace egress costs with an optional tracing cap add-on.

If ACME is willing to commit to 24 months and a 25% annualized ingest uplift guarantee, we can extend an extra 5% off the blended rate and roll onboarding credit into month 1. I’ll attach the workbook with worked examples.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercials | Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_addons_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing workbook)

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability needs — retention + tracing packaging question

Samir — technical clarifications to make numbers more precise:
1) The effective cost for tracing depends heavily on average span size and retention window — the sample you sent has uneven spans. I ran the sample at 100% hotpath and 5% background and the blended traced-span footprint is ~2.8x the metric-only footprint.
2) For seatless retention we recommend using the 60-day hot window + 90-day cold archive split; the cold archive can be tiered with lower egress to keep monthly credits predictable.
3) If you want a single-line budget figure for finance, we can produce a capped scenario (committed credits + tracing cap) that guarantees a monthly high-water mark. That’s what Ben’s 24-month concession maps to.

I added a small worked example in the attached CSV and a suggested retention profile. If you agree, we can bake these numbers into the contract language (SOW) for clarity on overage/ingest reconciliation.

Jordan Blake
Product Lead, Observability | Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention-sample-metrics.csv (derived analysis)

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-retail.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acme-retail.com>, contracts@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability needs — retention + tracing packaging question

Team — this is exactly what finance wanted to see. The blended $/GB examples and the 24-month concession hit the internal hurdle rate. A few quick asks before we proceed:
- Please convert Option A into a one-page SOW with the 60TB/month baseline, 24-month commitment, and the 5% additional concession.
- Add a short clause that tracing overage will be reconciled monthly with a cap mechanism (we’re OK with a cap at 150% of the committed trace budget).
- Can you push DocuSign for the SOW and the NDA redline we agreed on? I’ve looped in contracts.

If you can deliver the SOW draft and DocuSign link by EOD Thu we’ll route for signatures on Friday.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Infrastructure
Acme Retail

Attachment: Acme_SOW_draft_2026-09-29.pdf (placeholder PDF)
